# Location scope (display only): the stored years of the Stored Food step the province carries (its whole months
# / 12; pp_food_store_step holds the step + 100). 0 without one.
pp_stored_food_years = {
	value = 0
	province ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_food_store_step var:pp_food_store_step > 99.5 }
			add = var:pp_food_store_step
			subtract = 100
		}
	}
	divide = 12
	min = 0
}

# Location scope (display only): the Stored Food step (pp_food_store_<s>) the province carries, -1 without one; the
# location view's food chip shows that step modifier itself.
pp_stored_food_step = {
	value = -1
	province ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_food_store_step var:pp_food_store_step > 99.5 }
			add = var:pp_food_store_step
			subtract = 99.0
		}
	}
}
